entities.description: Owner of forges whose output doubled.

events.summary: Adi Thandray designed a helm as a tribute to his mentor Daljit Gavaskar.
events.quote: Adi Thandray designed this helm as a tribute to his mentor, the great Daljit Gavaskar.

events.summary: Jitya Reyath isolated liquid aether at room temperature.
events.quote: By isolating liquid aether at room temperature, foundry hand Jitya Reyath has given us a glimpse of raw aetheric matter

events.summary: Venya Sangmi realized her childhood vision after a lifetime.
events.quote: It took the reclusive Venya Sangmi a lifetime to realize her childhood vision

events.summary: Venand Kapur built an automaton to watch his clockwork herds.
events.quote: Venand Kapur—known as the Gearherder—built this automaton to keep watch over his clockwork herds.

events.summary: Adi Thandray's angel was made a priority confiscation from the Fair.
events.quote: Adi Thandray's angel is a Priority One confiscation from the Fair.

events.summary: Baral intends to use a device to hamper mages among the renegades.
events.quote: he intends to use the device to hamper the 'mages' among the ranks of the renegades

events.summary: A device was submitted anonymously and its maker must be found.
events.quote: This device was submitted to the Fair anonymously.

events.summary: Consulate engineers adapted sky-dock assisters into a defense system for the Aether Spire.
events.quote: we were able to convert sky-dock assisters into a defense system for the Aether Spire.

relations.note: Adi Thandray's mentor was Daljit Gavaskar.
relations.quote: his mentor, the great Daljit Gavaskar
